title: Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
Join AEK Media, an award-winning digital marketing agency, and work remotely with a global team. You’ll help manage paid campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Pinterest and more.



This role is ideal for someone who already has hands-on paid media experience, wants to take greater ownership of campaign performance, and is eager to develop into a well-rounded digital marketer.







Your Role



Manage Paid Advertising



Build, manage, monitor and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, Pinterest and other platforms.



Own Campaign Performance



Regularly analyse results, identify opportunities and make optimisation decisions rather than simply following a checklist.



Client Setup & Tracking



Assist with client onboarding and ensure conversion tracking is implemented accurately across advertising platforms, GA4 and Google Tag Manager.



Reporting



Build and maintain clear reporting dashboards using Looker Studio and Google Sheets, turning campaign data into useful insights.



Strategy & Analysis



Develop campaigns around the customer journey, understand the role of different channels and use data to determine where budget should be allocated.



Commercial Thinking



Understand that campaign success goes beyond clicks and leads. Consider lead quality, conversion rates, acquisition costs, customer value and the commercial objectives of each client.



Collaboration



Work closely with strategists, creatives, developers and account managers to improve campaign performance and deliver strong client outcomes.



Website Updates



Make minor updates to client websites and landing pages, and coordinate larger changes with our development team.



About You



2+ years of hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns, ideally across multiple client accounts.



You should be comfortable independently working inside Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, rather than having only reporting or account coordination experience.



You have experience with campaign setup, audience targeting, keyword research, bidding, budget management, creative testing and ongoing optimisation.



You can look at campaign data and explain what is happening, why it is happening and what you would do next.



You understand key performance metrics such as CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversion rate, CTR and CPC, and know when each metric matters.



You have working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking. Experience troubleshooting tracking issues is highly regarded.



You are comfortable working with Google Sheets or Excel and can confidently analyse campaign data.



You have strong attention to detail. You notice tracking discrepancies, incorrect URLs, budget issues, broken landing pages and other small problems before they become bigger ones.



You are proactive and comfortable taking ownership. If you see an issue, you investigate it and suggest a solution rather than waiting to be told what to do.



You can manage multiple client accounts and competing priorities in a fast-paced remote environment.



You communicate clearly in writing and can explain marketing performance to people who may not have a technical marketing background.



You are curious and want to understand why something works rather than simply replicating what you have seen elsewhere.



Highly Regarded



Experience managing campaigns across both lead generation and eCommerce accounts



Experience with LinkedIn Ads, Pinterest Ads or other paid media platforms



Looker Studio reporting experience



WordPress or Elementor experience



Landing page and CRO knowledge



Basic understanding of SEO



Experience working within an agency



Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets across multiple accounts



Why AEK Media?



Work remotely with a globally recognised, award-winning team.



Work across a diverse range of industries, campaign types and digital channels.



Develop your skills beyond simply managing ads, with exposure to strategy, analytics, CRO, creative, websites and broader digital marketing.



Take on greater responsibility as your skills develop, with genuine opportunities for career progression.



Join a culture that values transparency, merit and action.



Our Values



No Black Boxes – Transparency in all we do



Do Things Today, Not Tomorrow – Take action and keep things moving



Open Forum – Good ideas can come from anyone



Don’t Avoid the Details – The small things often make the biggest difference



Consider the Commercial – Marketing needs to deliver meaningful business outcomes



How to Apply



We welcome applications from people who may not meet every requirement. However, we are looking for candidates with genuine hands-on paid media experience who can demonstrate how they think about campaign performance.



Along with your CV, please include brief answers to the following:



1. Which advertising platforms have you personally managed?

2. What approximate monthly advertising budgets have you been responsible for?

3. Tell us about one campaign you improved. What was underperforming, what did you change and what happened?

4. What is your experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking?

5. How many client accounts or campaigns have you managed simultaneously?

6. What is one optimisation you would investigate if a campaign’s CPA suddenly increased by 50%?

7. Which areas of digital marketing are you most interested in developing over the next two years?



We’re less interested in textbook answers than in understanding how you think, how much ownership you’ve had, and how you approach solving problems.

**This is NOT a beginner position.**



We are looking for an experienced editor who understands professional wedding photography, culling, color correction, and maintaining consistency across an entire gallery.



The Position



This is a remote, long-term position with consistent work. You will receive **4 wedding photography projects per month**.



Each project includes:



- Reviewing and culling the provided wedding gallery. I will already pre-cull most of the gallery, you will take out the last
photos

images

- Maintaining consistent editing across different lighting conditions and cameras

- Delivering the completed Lightroom catalog and edited JPEGs

- Edited sneak peeks to use as a visual reference

- Editing instructions and expectations



**Important:** We do not want black-and-white edits. All delivered photographs must be in color.



Editing Style & Experience



Our editing style is inspired by Jose Villa, with an emphasis on **natural skin tones, soft yet accurate colors, clean whites, and timeless wedding photography**. No blue, green tints, vignette, or red hues



We use a modified Jose Villa preset, and the editor must be able to follow our established style rather than applying their own.



You should be comfortable with:



- Adobe Lightroom Classic

- Wedding photography culling

- Aftershoot or similar culling software - we use Aftershoot for the first round of culling before sending over

- Correcting white balance and exposure

- Maintaining natural skin tones

- Editing flash photography and mixed lighting

- Working with RAW photographs

- Matching provided sneak-peek edits

- Maintaining consistency across hundreds of images

- Organizing and delivering Lightroom catalogs



Experience editing large wedding galleries is required.



### Turnaround & Delivery



**Each completed project must be delivered within 10 calendar days of receiving the files.**



Final delivery must include:



1. **Lightroom Classic catalog (.lrcat)** containing all completed edits, ratings, and selections.

2. **200–400 edited, full-resolution JPEGs**, ready for client delivery.



Original RAW files do not need to be returned. All original filenames must remain unchanged so the Lightroom catalog can be reconnected to our files.



All images must match the provided preset and sneak-peek references.





### Compensation



**$450 USD per month for 4 completed projects ($112.50 per project).**

 address

title: Shopify eCommerce Growth & Development Manager | Hands-On Store Ownership | Remote
description:
**Job Type:** Part-time initially, with potential for long-term growth\

## About the Role



We are an Australian company managing and developing multiple eCommerce brands. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on **Shopify eCommerce Growth & Development Manager** who can take ownership of developing, improving, and growing our online stores.



**This is NOT a routine Shopify Store Administrator, Product Listing VA, or Order Management position.**



We need someone who understands how to build and develop an eCommerce business, not simply maintain its daily operations.



Your main responsibility will be to identify opportunities, plan improvements, and personally implement changes that enhance our Shopify stores, improve the customer journey, increase conversions, and support sustainable business growth.



You should be comfortable working both strategically and practically. We are not looking for someone who only prepares plans and delegates tasks. You must be capable of executing a significant portion of the work yourself.



Initially, the role will focus heavily on Shopify website development, store improvements, and conversion optimisation. Over time, responsibilities may expand into social media, digital marketing, brand development, and other growth initiatives.



## Key Responsibilities



**1. Shopify Store Development & Improvement (Primary Focus)**



- Take ownership of ongoing Shopify store development and improvement projects.

- Review existing stores, identify weaknesses, and recommend practical solutions.

- Improve homepage layouts, product pages, collections, navigation, menus, and overall website structure.

- Implement Shopify theme customisations, app configurations, and website enhancements.

- Develop new landing pages, promotional pages, product launches, and conversion-focused content.

- Coordinate with developers or designers for more technical tasks when required.



**2. Customer Journey & Conversion Optimisation**



- Analyse the complete customer journey, from first website visit through checkout.

- Identify friction points affecting customer experience, trust, and purchasing decisions.

- Improve product presentation, calls to action, mobile experience, and checkout flow.

- Recommend and implement improvements to increase conversion rates and average order value.

- Review competitor websites and introduce relevant improvements and best practices.

- Use Shopify Analytics, GA4, heatmaps, and other tools to identify improvement opportunities.



**3. eCommerce Business Development & Growth**



- Develop practical action plans for improving online store performance and sales.

- Identify opportunities for new products, bundles, promotions, upselling, and cross-selling.

- Support new brand launches and the development of new Shopify stores.

- Coordinate projects from initial concept through implementation and performance review.

- Monitor store performance, evaluate results, and continuously recommend improvements.



**4. Marketing & Brand Development (Secondary / Future Focus)**



- Support social media strategy, content planning, and brand development.

- Coordinate with designers, content creators, influencers, and marketing specialists.

- Assist with
 marketing, SEO, promotional campaigns, and customer retention initiatives.

- Identify opportunities to improve brand visibility, engagement, and customer acquisition.



## Mandatory Requirements



- Minimum **3 years of relevant hands-on Shopify and eCommerce development experience**.

- Demonstrated experience improving or developing Shopify stores, not just managing daily operations.

- Strong understanding of website UX, customer journey, conversion optimisation, and online sales.

- Ability to implement Shopify improvements independently, including themes, apps, pages, and store configurations.

- Proven experience taking ownership of projects from planning through execution.

- Ability to analyse problems, propose solutions, and implement improvements without constant instructions.

- Experience working with Australian eCommerce businesses.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong organisational skills, initiative, accountability, and attention to detail.



**Highly Regarded**



- Experience managing multiple eCommerce brands or working in an eCommerce agency.

- Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, or other relevant technical skills.

- Shopify SEO, Google Analytics 4, Google Merchant Center, and conversion tracking.

- Klaviyo,
 marketing, and customer retention strategies.

- Social media strategy and content development.

- Experience launching new online stores or developing brands from scratch.



## Who Should Apply?



We are particularly interested in candidates who can confidently say:



- I have personally built, developed, or significantly improved Shopify stores.

- I understand what makes customers trust a website and complete a purchase.

- I can independently identify problems and implement practical improvements.

- I can manage projects and deliver measurable outcomes, not just complete assigned tasks.

- I understand how different elements of an eCommerce business work together to generate sales.



**Please do not apply if your experience is primarily limited to product uploads, order processing, inventory updates, customer service, or routine store administration.**



## Mandatory Self-Assessment



Please rate your skills in each area using **None / Basic / Professional**.



1. Shopify store setup and development

2. Shopify theme customisation and editing

3. Shopify apps and integrations

4. Website UX and customer journey improvement

5. Conversion rate optimisation (CRO)

6. Product page and landing page development

7. Shopify store audits and performance improvement

8. Shopify Analytics and Google Analytics 4

9. eCommerce business growth strategy

10. Product launches, bundles, upselling, and promotions

11. Shopify SEO and website content optimisation

12. Shopify Liquid / HTML / CSS

13. eCommerce project management and ownership

14. Competitor research and market analysis

15. Klaviyo and
 marketing

16. Social media strategy and content development

17. Coordination of designers, developers, and marketers

18. Experience supporting Australian eCommerce businesses



## How to Apply



Please submit:



**1. Resume and relevant experience**



Include your years of Shopify experience and details of Australian eCommerce businesses you have supported.



**2. Shopify Portfolio – Mandatory**



Provide links to at least **three Shopify stores** you have personally developed, significantly improved, or managed through major enhancement projects.



For each store, briefly explain:



- What was the situation or problem?

- What improvements did you personally implement?

- What results did you achieve?



**3. Introduction Video – Maximum 3 Minutes**



Record a short video explaining:



- Your relevant Shopify and eCommerce development experience.

- One or two significant Shopify projects you personally delivered.

- How you approach improving an existing Shopify store.

- Why you believe you are suitable for this ownership-focused role.



Upload your video to Loom, Google Drive, or a similar platform and provide a link accessible without requesting permission or entering a password.



**4. Completed Self-Assessment**



Use the checklist above.



**5. Expected Hourly Rate and Availability**



Provide your expected hourly rate in AUD and weekly availability.



## Important Application Notes



Applications without the required **portfolio, introduction video, and completed self-assessment** will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to demonstrate previous Shopify projects during an interview, explain the changes they personally implemented, and discuss the outcomes achieved.



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term contributor to the development and growth of our eCommerce businesses, not simply another person completing routine administrative tasks.

title: Garage Door Operations Manager | Supplier & Purchasing Coordination
description:
We are looking for an experienced Garage Door Operations Manager to manage the daily coordination of door orders, suppliers, purchasing, and installations for a U.S. home services business.



You will take ownership of the process from an approved customer order through purchasing, delivery, installation, and completion. We need someone organized and proactive who can communicate confidently with U.S. suppliers, customers, and technicians and keep multiple jobs moving without constant supervision.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Communicate with door manufacturers, distributors, and suppliers by phone and
 to obtain quotes, confirm specifications, check stock, and verify lead times.

- Coordinate purchases of garage doors, openers, parts, and installation materials within approved budgets and purchasing procedures.

- Confirm measurements, models, colors, styles, insulation, hardware, and other order details with the field team before submitting supplier orders.

- Prepare and maintain purchase orders, compare supplier quotes, confirm pricing and freight costs, and check order acknowledgments for accuracy.

- Track orders from placement through production, shipment, delivery, or pickup, and follow up proactively on delays and backorders.

- Coordinate supplier deliveries and pickups with technicians and installation schedules so materials are ready when needed.

- Keep customers and team members updated on order status, expected timelines, and scheduling changes.

- Handle damaged, missing, or incorrect items with suppliers and coordinate returns, replacements, warranty claims, and credits.

- Maintain accurate job records, purchasing logs, supplier information, and CRM updates; check supplier invoices against purchase orders and flag discrepancies.

- Manage daily workflows and follow-ups, coordinate team priorities, resolve operational issues, and report outstanding orders, delays, and bottlenecks to ownership.

- Improve purchasing, scheduling, and handoff processes to reduce errors, avoid missed installations, and keep jobs on track.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

- Previous operations, purchasing, supplier coordination, or project coordination experience supporting a U.S. business.

- Prior experience in home services, construction, or a related trade, with an understanding of materials, field teams, and job scheduling.

- Strong experience communicating with U.S. customers and business partners. Previous U.S. sales experience is required, including discussing pricing, handling objections, and following up professionally.

- Experience coordinating purchases and tracking orders, delivery dates, and multiple active jobs.

- Management or team coordination experience, with a track record of taking ownership and following tasks through to completion.

- Excellent spoken and written English, strong attention to detail, and confidence speaking with suppliers by phone.

- Ability to read quotes, purchase orders, product specifications, and invoices accurately and resolve discrepancies.

- Experience with CRM or job management software, spreadsheets,
, and online supplier portals.

- Availability during agreed U.S. business hours, reliable internet, a headset, and a quiet workspace.



PREFERRED

- Direct garage door industry experience, including ordering doors, openers, hardware, and replacement parts.

- Familiarity with garage door measurements, configurations, product options, and installation requirements.

- Experience with Jobber, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, or similar home services software.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. Your resume and a brief summary of your U.S. home services, operations, purchasing, and sales experience.

2. Examples of how you have coordinated suppliers, managed orders, or resolved a delivery issue that affected a scheduled job.

3. REQUIRED: A short Loom video introduction explaining your relevant experience and how you would handle a supplier delay when an installation is already scheduled. Include a shareable Loom video link with your application. Applications without a video introduction will not be considered.

4. The systems you have used, your availability during U.S. business hours, and your expected compensation.



Use the subject line: Garage Door Operations Manager.

- Able to recreate an editing style based on a reference video

- Comfortable working with talking-head content

- Reliable communication and internet connection

title: Senior Structural Steel Detailer / Tekla Modeller – Australian Projects
description:
Senior Structural Steel Detailer / Tekla Modeller – Australian Projects



Employment: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Salary: AUD $1,000–$2,000 per month, negotiable based on experience

₱44,915.70 to ₱89,831.40 PHP per month



About Us



Construction company specialising in structural steel supply, fabrication, installation and structural alterations across residential, commercial and industrial projects.



We are looking for an experienced and reliable Structural Steel Detailer / Tekla Modeller to join our team on a long-term basis.



This is an opportunity to work directly with an Australian construction company, with potential for career progression, increased responsibilities, salary reviews and promotion as the business expands.



We are seeking someone who can work independently, understand Australian engineering requirements and deliver accurate, practical drawings suitable for fabrication and installation.



Key Responsibilities



1. Structural Steel Detailing & Shop Drawings



Develop accurate 3D structural steel models using Tekla Structures.



Prepare complete fabrication shop drawings, assembly drawings, single-part drawings and erection/marking plans.



Detail steel connections including base plates, cleats, stiffeners, bolted connections and welds in accordance with approved engineering documentation.



Prepare fabrication-ready drawings, cutting lists, material schedules and NC/DXF files where required.



Review architectural and structural engineering drawings to identify clashes, discrepancies and missing information.



Prepare RFIs and coordinate drawing revisions.



Understand fabrication processes, installation sequencing, site tolerances and constructability.



Assist with design development and detailing solutions, subject to structural engineer review and approval where required.



2. Structural Steel Material Take-Offs



Independently review structural and architectural drawing packages.



Identify the complete structural steel scope of works.



Prepare accurate material take-offs including UB, UC, PFC, RHS, SHS, CHS, angles, plates and other structural steel members.



Calculate member quantities, lengths, linear metres, unit weights and total steel tonnage.



Identify associated connection materials, plates, cleats and other fabrication requirements.



Prepare organised Excel material schedules suitable for supplier enquiries and project pricing.



Clearly identify exclusions, assumptions and missing information.



3. Estimating & Pricing – Future Development Opportunity



As the successful candidate becomes familiar with our business and demonstrates strong technical capability, we would like to expand their responsibilities into:



Preparing structural steel estimates using our company pricing schedules.



Assisting with fabrication, coatings, delivery and installation allowances.



Preparing professional client pricing proposals using MIREK templates.



Assisting with tender submissions and project cost breakdowns.



Previous estimating experience will be highly regarded but is not essential. Our immediate priority is structural steel detailing, shop drawings and accurate material take-offs.



Essential Requirements



Minimum 5 years' professional experience in structural steel detailing, preferably 7+ years.



Advanced proficiency in Tekla Structures.



Must have their own legitimate, active Tekla Structures licence and software access suitable for commercial steel detailing work.



Proven experience producing fabrication shop drawings for Australian structural steel projects.



Strong understanding of Australian Standards, including AS 4100 and AS/NZS 5131, as applicable to the role.



Ability to interpret structural engineering and architectural drawings independently.



Sound understanding of structural steel connections, fabrication requirements and installation methods.



Ability to prepare accurate material take-offs and Excel schedules.



Excellent attention to detail, communication and time management.



Reliable computer, internet connection and ability to work remotely.



Career Development & Promotion



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term career with MIREK Construction.



The successful candidate will initially focus on steel detailing, shop drawings and material take-offs.



As our business grows, there will be opportunities to progress into a Senior Detailer, Estimator or Detailing Team Leader position, with increased responsibilities and salary reviews based on performance.



Our long-term objective is to build a dedicated detailing and estimating department, and we would like the right person to grow with us.



How to Apply



Please provide:



Your CV and years of structural steel detailing experience.



Examples of previous Tekla models and fabrication shop drawings, preferably from Australian projects.



An example of a structural steel material take-off or Excel material schedule.



Confirmation that you have your own licensed Tekla Structures software.



Details of your experience working with Australian Standards and fabrication requirements.



Your expected monthly salary in AUD.



Your availability to commence employment.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an online interview and a paid technical assessment.



Important: Applications without evidence of previous Tekla shop drawing experience will not be considered.



We look forward to finding the right person to join our team.

title: Youtube editor for Reaction Channel
description:
Hi, I'm looking for an experienced editor to edit my music video reactions in the style shown in the attached video from a previous editor.



My YouTube channel is **nbskole**, currently sitting at around 16,500 subscribers, and I’m looking for someone who can help me take the channel to the next level through entertaining, high-quality reaction videos.



What I’m looking for:



I need an editor who understands music video reactions and, most importantly, understands YouTube copyright policies and Content ID claims.



I want my videos to stay entertaining while minimising copyright risks. This means knowing how to use strategic cuts, zooms, transitions, pacing, and commentary to keep viewers engaged without showing the original music videos for unnecessarily long periods.



I’m looking for someone who knows how to balance entertainment with copyright awareness while maintaining the natural feel of a reaction video. No editor can guarantee that a video will be copyright-free, but I want someone who knows how to minimise the risks through smart editing.



Workload and payment:



My budget is **A$500 AUD per month** for ongoing editing work.



I’m looking to build a long-term relationship with an editor who can consistently deliver quality videos and work with me as the channel grows. Please let me know how many videos you can realistically edit per month within this budget, along with your average turnaround time.



As the channel continues to grow, I’m also open to increasing payment as the workload expands and the results improve.



How to apply:



If you're interested, please provide:



- Examples of reaction videos or similar content you’ve edited.

- Your experience with YouTube copyright policies and Content ID claims.

- An explanation of how you would edit my videos to keep them entertaining while minimising copyright risks.

- How many videos you can edit per month within my budget.

- Your turnaround time and availability for ongoing work.



I’ll be looking through all applicants, so I expect demonstrated experience in reaction video editing and copyright risk management as a minimum. I want someone who can keep the videos entertaining, understand the audience, and help me continue growing the channel.



I’m serious about building the channel long-term and want an editor who is equally committed to producing quality content.



Thank you for your time. I look forward to reviewing your work and seeing how you can help me reach this goal.

title: VA - Guest Communication & Operations @ Restay Homes
description:
Hi!



My name is Nikita, I'm the founder of Restay Vacation Homes Rental - a short-term rental management company based in Dubai.



We manage 35+ furnished apartments in Dubai under sublease and property management, from studios to 3-bedrooms. We've held Airbnb Superhost status for the past year with a 4.8-4.9 rating across the whole portfolio, and we're adding units every month.



We're looking for one more VA to join our operations team.



WHAT THE JOB ACTUALLY IS



Communication is most of it. You'll be in our CRM, in Slack and on WhatsApp all day - talking to guests, cleaners, maintenance, contractors, suppliers and owners, and keeping our internal team informed. The rest is paperwork: passport and registration documents, DTCM, records, reports. Getting it right, and getting it finished.



Guest relations:



- Manage guest communication, inbound and outbound

- Coordinate check-in and check-out

- Handle issues during a stay and follow them through to a result, not just a reply

- Coordinate cleaners and suppliers via WhatsApp and Slack



Maintenance coordination:



- Log every reported issue and keep it visible until it's actually fixed

- Dispatch technicians, including after hours, and confirm the job was done

- Chase contractors and suppliers who go quiet

- Spot problems that keep coming back and say so



New unit launches:



- Coordinate a new apartment from handover to first booking - furniture delivery, installation, deep clean, photos, keys and access

- Handle the paperwork: DTCM registration, documents, listing setup across platforms

- Keep the owner and the internal team updated on where each unit stands



Operations and admin:



- Collect and process guest documents for registration - on time, every time

- Keep our CRM accurate: bookings, unit status, guest records

- Prepare and check reports and documents

- Escalate the right things to the senior team, and only the right things



Systems, as you grow into it:



- Write and maintain SOPs

- Improve how the team works, not just do the tasks

- Build simple automations between our tools



TWO THINGS MATTER MORE TO US THAN ANYTHING ELSE



You chase things until they're done.



Most of this job is waiting on other people - a guest who hasn't sent a document, a contractor who read your message and didn't answer, an owner sitting on an approval. Asking once is not doing the task. We need someone who tracks every open thread, notices who has gone quiet, and pushes again - politely, on a schedule, switching channel and escalating when it isn't working. Silence from the other side is not a finished task.



You check before you answer.



When a source contradicts what we've written, or something doesn't add up, stop and find out which is true rather than passing on the first answer you found. Being right matters more here than being fast, and one good question beats a confident wrong answer.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- You follow up. You have a real system for tracking what you're waiting on

- You verify. You notice when two sources disagree and you resolve it

- Fluent English, written and spoken - natural and clear, not translated-sounding

- You own tasks. You d
 what you can d
 and escalate what you can't

- Structured. You follow SOPs, and you write them when they're missing

- Accurate with detail - numbers, dates, documents

- Comfortable with CRMs, Google Sheets, Slack, WhatsApp



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- 6+ months in Airbnb operations or another short-term rental company

- 6+ months in a small team or startup

- Experience helping a company scale from 10 to 50+ units is a big plus

- Familiarity with guest communication, pricing tools, turnover coordination

- Experience writing SOPs or building team processes



WHAT WE OFFER



- $4-6/hour depending on experience

- Flexible workload, 40-60 hrs/week, 5-6 days - you tell us what suits you

- Direct work with the founder, fast decisions, no bureaucracy

- Opportunity to grow into Team Lead as we scale



HOW TO APPLY



We don't accept direct messages. Applications without a completed form are ignored.



The application has two parts:



Part 1 - a short form about you and your experience (about 10 minutes)

Part 2 - five real situations from our operations. You'll get the link right after you submit Part 1. You have 60 minutes from that moment, and we record how long it takes.



Part 2 has no trick questions and no perfect answers. We want to see how you think and how fast you get to a result.



Form:



Looking forward to hearing from you!



Nikita

title: Delivery and Calling Assistant (Websites, SEO and Follow-Up Calls), Part-Time to Start, Growing Over Time
description:
PAY AND HOURS

CAD $4 to $5 per hour (Canadian dollars), depending on skill and experience. You are paid for the full 3-hour block each day, twice a month through Wise or PayPal, from your logged hours. Part-time, up to 3 hours a day, Monday to Friday (up to 15 hours a week), 12:00 PM to 3:00 PM Eastern Time (Canada). Hours and work grow as you do well. Paid trial first, then long-term. Applicants: please state your hourly rate in Canadian dollars.



ABOUT US

Aries Labs is a small marketing and web agency. We run ads and build websites for local businesses in Canada. One of our clients is a health and wellness clinic in Ontario. We are a small team, we write things down, and we train you properly.



THE ROLE

You are part of our delivery team: the people who get client work finished and checked. Your day is a mix of two things: follow-up calls, and delivery work on client websites, Google presence and reporting. Brand-new leads are handled by us, so you are never waiting for an alert. Your three hours are planned and calm. This is the start of a role that grows: when you do well, we give you more hours and more work.



THE WORK IS DONE OUR WAY

We have our own tools and written step-by-step guides (we call them SOPs) for every task, and you follow them. No technical, coding or design background is needed. We train you on each task before you do it, and we review everything before a client sees it.



YOUR SHIFT (IMPORTANT, READ THIS)

12:00 PM to 3:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday to Friday. In the Philippines that is 12:00 AM to 3:00 AM until 1 November, then 1:00 AM to 4:00 AM. Please only apply if you can be awake, in a quiet room, with a good headset and a stable internet connection (and a backup plan) at those hours.



WHAT YOU WILL DO: DELIVERY WORK

- Websites: polish quick demo sites before a sales call (swap in better photos, fix small things), build the remaining pages of a client site once the design is set, and build landing pages and connect their forms. You follow the design we lock; you do not redesign it.

- Checking: read finished sites before a client sees them, against the client's own wording. Click every link, test every form, check on a phone.

- SEO (helping a site show up on Google): find the topics local customers search for, write blog posts and page text with AI help from our templates, and fix the wording on pages.

- Google business profiles: keep opening hours and contact details correct and upload the real photos clients send us (never AI-made images).

- Back-office: test our lead system after a change using a checklist, pull the weekly numbers for client reports, draft replies to online reviews for us to approve, and clean lead lists.

- We hand these over one at a time, starting with the simplest, and with a guide for each.



WHAT YOU WILL DO: CALLS

- Make the call-backs that are booked for your hours. Our system tells you who to call and when.

- Work through the backlog: people who did not answer and need another try. Leave a voi
 and send the saved text when there is no answer.

- Call clients the day before their visit to confirm it, and call anyone who missed a visit to offer a new time.

- Book the visit in the clinic's booking software. You never see health records.

- Log every call and move the lead's card to the right stage. Hand anything unusual to us.



Send a short note at the end of each shift: what you did and what is left.



GROWING IN THE ROLE

More hours, more types of work, and then more clients as we sign them. How fast depends on the work you show us.



YOU MUST HAVE

- A clear, warm, natural voice and excellent spoken English that is easy for Canadian callers to understand. We will ask for a voice recording.

- Phone or call-centre experience with appointment setting, booking or customer service.

- Comfortable with computers and happy to use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar). You follow written instructions step by step.

- Experience in health, wellness or beauty. You do not give health advice; you book people in.



HOW WE WORK

- Training in your first days: handbook, short videos, then your first calls with us listening. We review a sample of your recorded calls each week at the start.

- You get logins only for what the job needs, added one at a time. You do not get our company passwords. You sign a confidentiality agreement before you see any lead.

- When you start website work, we pay for the AI tool you need, up to about CAD $25 a month, on your own account.

- One 30-minute check-in call a week, during your shift, and the end-of-shift note on Slack.



PAID TEST AND TRIAL

Shortlisted applicants do a short paid test (about 1 to 2 hours, paid at $1 an hour less than your rate): a practice call with us, and one small task done by following one of our step-by-step guides. Then a two-week paid trial at your full rate. After a week we review your work together. If it goes well, we move to a long-term arrangement with a monthly review, and talk about more hours.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply with:

I saw you asked about [a service]. I'd love to get you booked in. Do you have a minute?" Then say, in your own words, how you would handle someone who says "I'm not sure, can I think about it?"

title: Operations, Admin and Job Scheduling Assistant
description:
A growing family-owned lawn care and garden maintenance business based in Perth, Western Australia, is looking for an experienced Operations, Admin and Job Scheduling Assistant.



The company provides professional lawn mowing, garden care and outdoor maintenance services across a large area of Perth, with a particular focus on premium and high-end residential properties.



The business is moving away from traditional “mow and go” garden maintenance and is focused on providing a more tailored, professional and high-quality service to clients who value the presentation and ongoing care of their properties.



The field team currently includes qualified horticulturalists who carry out the on-site work, while the Director manages business operations, sales, client relationships, scheduling and administration.



As the business continues to grow, the company is looking for someone who can take ownership of key back-end functions and help keep daily operations running smoothly.



About the Role



We are seeking a reliable, organised and proactive Operations, Admin and Job Scheduling Assistant to support the Director with the day-to-day running of the business.



A major part of the role will be managing and updating schedules through Sortscape, coordinating changes to recurring and project-based jobs, reviewing completed job cards, following up with field staff, communicating with clients and helping ensure all required information has been completed correctly.



The role will also support accounts receivable and bookkeeping activities through Xero, including reconciliations, receipt and document management, invoice follow-up and preparation of bookkeeping records for review by the company’s Australian accountant.



This is a hands-on role suited to someone who is comfortable working across administration, operations and bookkeeping rather than focusing on only one area.



The goal of the role is to take the day-to-day administrative workload away from the Director so he can spend more time on sales, client relationships and growing the business.



Key Duties & Responsibilities



Scheduling & Operational Coordination



Manage and maintain the daily and recurring work schedule in Sortscape.

Schedule new customer bookings and additional project-based work around existing recurring services.

Allocate jobs based on team availability, working hours, location and geographic efficiency.

Adjust schedules when jobs change, additional work is required, or weather affects operations.

Manage rain-day rescheduling and communicate updated booking arrangements with customers.

Ensure project-based jobs are scheduled with enough time so they do not affect the team’s regular service schedule.

Monitor the daily schedule and flag potential clashes, delays or operational issues.

Work closely with the Director and field team to keep the schedule accurate and achievable.



Sortscape Job Card Management



Review completed Sortscape job cards after field work has been completed.

Compare work completed against the original scheduled or quoted work.

Check that required job information and compliance details have been completed correctly.

Follow up with field staff where job cards are incomplete or information is missing.

Review notes and observations added by the field team.

Identify additional work or maintenance requirements raised during site visits.

Contact customers where appropriate regarding recommended additional work.

Arrange follow-up work or allow additional time at future visits where required.

Check that photographs and other relevant job information have been uploaded.



Customer Communication & Administration



Respond to general customer enquiries and provide timely follow-up.

Contact customers regarding schedule changes, rain delays, additional works and booking updates.

Maintain professional and consistent communication with customers.

Follow up with customers regarding work identified by the field team.

Maintain accurate customer records and job information within Sortscape and other business systems.

Assist with general day-to-day administration as required.

Help ensure outstanding tasks and follow-ups are actioned rather than left unresolved.



Business & Management Support



Assist the Director with general administrative tasks that reduce the day-to-day back-end workload.

Maintain accurate records across operational and financial systems.

Assist with simple reporting on outstanding invoices, scheduling, workload or other business information.

Help document and improve administrative processes as the role develops.

Proactively identify outstanding actions and follow them through.

Assist with additional operational or administrative duties as the business grows.



SECONDARY ROLE:



Invoicing & Accounts Receivable

Assist with preparing and issuing customer invoices.

Monitor outstanding invoices and accounts receivable.

Follow up professionally with customers regarding overdue payments.

Maintain accurate notes and records of payment follow-ups.

Escalate overdue or disputed accounts to the Director where required.

Assist with the administration of recurring or subscription-based maintenance arrangements as the business continues to develop these services.

Help improve processes around invoicing and payment follow-up to reduce outstanding accounts.



Bookkeeping & Xero Support



Complete routine bookkeeping and data-entry tasks in Xero.

Complete regular bank reconciliations.

Record income and expenses accurately.

Upload and attach receipts, invoices, vouchers and supporting documents to transactions.

Review transactions and ensure supporting documentation is complete.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date bookkeeping records.

Assist with preparing bookkeeping information required for BAS.

Prepare relevant Xero reports and activity statement information for review by the Australian accountant.

Liaise with the Director regarding any unusual, unclear or missing transactions.

Maintain accurate financial records to support business reporting and decision-making.



Please note: BAS review and lodgement will remain with the company’s Australian accountant or registered BAS agent.



Industry-Related Experience & Qualifications



Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accountancy or a related finance field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Previous experience as an Administrative Assistant, Operations Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Bookkeeper or similar role.

title: Operations, Administration and Accounts Assistant
description:
Location: Work from Home (Philippines)

Contract Type: Independent Contractor | Part-time initially (20 hours per week), with potential to increase to full-time

Working Hours: To be agreed, aligned with Adelaide business hours



About the Business



We are seeking an experienced, highly organised and proactive Operations, Administration & Accounts Assistant to support a growing air conditioning business based in Adelaide, South Australia.



The business is an established air conditioning specialist providing installation, servicing, repairs and preventative maintenance for residential and light commercial customers across metropolitan Adelaide.



With over 20 years of industry experience, the business specialises in evaporative cooling, ducted reverse-cycle air conditioning, gas ducted heating, and light commercial air conditioning.



About the Role



We are looking for a versatile, detail-oriented and proactive administrative all-rounder to provide back-office support across operations, accounts, job management, reporting and marketing.



The role will focus on maintaining accurate information in Ascora or similar software or tools and Xero, checking job records, assisting with financial administration, preparing technician performance reports, supporting
 marketing campaigns and documenting business processes.



You will work closely with the business owner and existing office team to ensure that administrative tasks are completed accurately and on time, particularly during busy periods.



This is primarily a back-office support role. You will not be responsible for answering incoming customer calls, managing appointment bookings or directly scheduling technicians, as these responsibilities are handled by the on-site team.

The position will initially be part-time, with the opportunity to increase to full-time as the business grows and the responsibilities expand.



Key Responsibilities



1. Job Management & Operational Administration –Ascora or similar software or tools

- Review job records in Ascora or similar software or tools to ensure information is accurate, complete and up to date.

- Check that jobs are assigned to the correct technicians and that job details match the actual work completed.

- Verify that equipment and asset information, including make, model and serial numbers, has been recorded correctly.

- Review job cards, technician timesheets, materials used and supporting documents for missing or incorrect information.

- Identify incomplete jobs, outstanding information and administrative discrepancies.

- Track unfinished jobs, outstanding tasks and reminders, and pass follow-up actions to the office team.

- Check that completed jobs have been invoiced and correctly transferred from Ascora or similar software or tools  to Xero.

- Assist with entering and attaching supplier invoices to the relevant jobs.

- Identify discrepancies in job records, invoicing and payments, and report these to management.

- Help maintain accurate job data to support reliable operational and financial reporting.

- Prepare repetitive and predictable quotations for approval and finalisation by management.

- Update and upload our inventory supplier pricing using templates and files.

- Build out and maintain our price books for our technicians to quote customers on site.



2. Bookkeeping & Accounts Administration – Xero

- Complete bank feed reconciliations in Xero.

- Enter and process supplier invoices in Ascora or similar software or tools and Xero.

- Review outstanding payments, EFT transactions and invoice discrepancies.

- Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable administration.

- Update and maintain the cash banking spreadsheet.

- Review technicians job run sheets and action items that require attention

- Prepare and update the end-of-month supplier payables spreadsheet.

-
 customer statements and follow up on overdue invoices.

- Assist with resolving outstanding invoice and payment queries.

- Prepare payroll information and supporting documentation for management approval.

- Assist with supplier payment preparation and end-of-month financial processes.

- Generate financial reports and summaries for management.

- Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.



3. Reporting, KPI Tracking & Business Performance

- Generate and review reports from Ascora to ensure the accuracy of job and financial information.

- Prepare reports identifying:

  - Job booking and technician assignment discrepancies.

  - Invoices transferred from Ascora to Xero.

  - Jobs completed but not invoiced.

  - Payments not collected and outstanding invoices.

  - Technician quotes and outstanding quotation activity.

- Prepare weekly technician labour utilisation reports.

- Track technician performance against established KPIs and Key Performance Areas (KPAs).

- Update and maintain technician performance scoreboards.

- Monitor minimum and average invoice values.

- Complete monthly job data and business performance reports.

- Update lead source tracking spreadsheets.

- Compile operational reports for the business owner and Service Manager.

- Identify inconsistencies, missing information and opportunities to improve reporting accuracy.



4. Systems, SOPs & Process Improvement

- Document existing business processes and administrative workflows.

- Convert the business owner's voice notes and instructions into clear, structured procedures.

- Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), checklists and workflow guides and screen recording videos.

- Develop process flowcharts and step-by-step instructions where appropriate.

- Assist with building a comprehensive business operations manual.

- Review existing administrative processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency.

- Help standardise procedures across job management, accounts, reporting and administration.

- Maintain organised digital records and documentation.

- Assist with implementing simple workflow improvements and automation where appropriate.

- Ensure processes are clearly documented to support staff training, consistency and future business growth.



5.
 Marketing & Customer Database Management

- Assist with preparing, updating and scheduling
 marketing campaigns through Mailchimp.

- Maintain accurate customer records and equipment information for targeted campaigns.

- Segment customer mailing lists according to their heating and cooling equipment, including ducted gas heaters, split systems and other installations.

- Assist with preparing seasonal cooling and heating service reminder campaigns.

- Manage the preparation of regular customer engagement
s, ideally once or twice per month.

- Use existing
 templates and update content, images and customer information as required.

- Review marketing
s for accuracy before scheduling or sending.

- Maintain mailing lists and ensure customer information is correctly recorded.

- Assist with basic
 marketing reporting and campaign tracking.

- Support other marketing administration tasks as required.



6. General Back-Office Administration & Compliance Support

- Provide general administrative support to the business owner and on-site office team.

- Maintain organised electronic records, spreadsheets and business documentation.

- Prepare reports, summaries and other administrative documents.

- Track outstanding administrative tasks and coordinate follow-ups with the relevant team members.

- Create and maintain reminders for company vehicle servicing.

- Track staff licensing, training requirements and renewal dates.

- Maintain relevant registers, records and compliance reminders.

- Assist with supplier and business information updates.

- Support accurate recordkeeping across the business's administrative systems.

- Help ensure routine administrative tasks are completed during busy operational periods.



7. Commercial Tendering & Project Administration (As Required)

- Assist with administrative preparation of commercial quotations and tenders as the business expands into commercial opportunities.

- Organise supplier information, pricing documents and supporting records.

- Maintain tender documentation and submission checklists.

- Track important tender deadlines and outstanding requirements.

- Assist with basic project administration and document preparation.

- Provide administrative support to the business owner and Service Manager during the tendering process.



Commercial tendering is a potential future responsibility rather than a primary requirement at commencement.



​Skills and Qualifications



Essential Requirements



- Degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

- Proven experience in administration, bookkeeping or operations support, preferably within an Australian trade or service business.

- Strong working knowledge of Xero, particularly bank reconciliations, supplier invoices, accounts payable, accounts receivable and financial reporting.

- Experience using Ascora or similar job management systems, such as Simpro, ServiceM8, Aroflo or Tradify.

- Understanding of job records, work orders, job costing and technician timesheets.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including spreadsheets, data validation, report preparation and tracking.

- Proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Excel and Word.

- Experience preparing operational reports and maintaining accurate business records.

- Strong attention to detail, particularly when reviewing financial information and job management data.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities independently.

- Proactive approach to identifying errors, following up on incomplete tasks and maintaining accurate records.



Highly Regarded



- Hands-on experience with Ascora or similar software or tools

- Experience supporting an Australian air conditioning, refrigeration, electrical, plumbing, construction or other trade business.

- Experience with Australian bookkeeping and payroll processes.

- Experience generating operational reports, technician productivity reports or KPI scoreboards.

- Experience using Mailchimp, including
 templates, customer segmentation and scheduled campaigns.

- Experience documenting business processes and preparing SOPs.

- Experience developing spreadsheets, reporting templates and workflow checklists.

- Exposure to commercial tendering, quotations or project administration.

- Familiarity with customer asset registers, equipment records and maintenance reminders.

- Knowledge of AI tools and workflow automation.

- Experience supporting a small business owner across multiple operational and administrative functions.



Personal Qualities:



We're looking for someone who is:

- An all-rounder – Comfortable handling a variety of administrative, operational and accounts-related tasks.

- Detail-oriented – Able to identify errors, discrepancies and missing information before they become bigger issues.

- Proactive – Takes initiative, follows up on outstanding tasks and does not require constant reminders.

- Organised – Able to manage competing priorities, deadlines and recurring administrative responsibilities.

- Analytical – Comfortable working with spreadsheets, reports and performance data.

- Reliable and accountable – Takes ownership of tasks and follows through until completion.

- Resourceful – Able to investigate problems, find information and suggest practical improvements.

- Adaptable – Comfortable working in a growing business where priorities and responsibilities may change.

- A strong communicator – Able to communicate clearly with the business owner, office team and other stakeholders.



Tools Experience: 



Experience with the following would be an advantage:

- Ascora or any similar software or tools

- Xero

- Microsoft 365

- Mailchimp

- CRM Systems

-
 Marketing Platforms

- Process Documentation Tools

- AI & Automation Tools – ChatGPT, Zapier, Power Automate or similar



Key Success Factors: 



- Accurate Job Records – Ensure job, technician and equipment information is correctly recorded in the system. .

- Reliable Accounts Administration – Keep Xero reconciliations, invoices, payables and receivables accurate and up to date.

- Consistent Reporting – Prepare reliable weekly and monthly reports, KPI scoreboards and technician performance summaries.

- Effective Follow-ups – Identify unfinished jobs, missing information and outstanding accounts matters, and ensure they are brought to the attention of the appropriate team members.

- Well-Documented Processes – Help develop clear SOPs and workflow documentation that improve consistency and reduce reliance on the business owner.

- Timely Marketing Support – Assist with preparing and scheduling targeted Mailchimp campaigns and regular customer communications.

- Administrative Efficiency – Ensure back-office tasks continue to be completed accurately, even during busy periods.

- Ownership & Initiative – Work independently, manage priorities, and proactively keep the business owner informed of progress and issues.



If you believe you have the experience and skills we're looking for, we'd love to hear from you!



Please read the entire job description carefully before submitting your application to ensure you understand the responsibilities and requirements of the role.



To apply, please include the following:



Your updated CV or resume. Use "I am your next Super Administration and Accounts Assistant" as the subject line of your application so we know you've read the entire job posting.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
ABOUT US



We're a fast-growing Australian company working across the fashion, retail and beauty industries. Our fully remote team has grown from around 30 to almost 50 people in the past year, and we're still growing.



Our Filipino team members are employed through our Philippine company, with full local benefits.



OUR CULTURE



We're a positive, supportive team that genuinely cares about its people. Our values are integrity, compassion, resilience, trust and exceptional delivery, and we hire people who live them. You'll be treated as a valued member of the team, not just a remote worker, with founders who back you, recognise good work and want you to grow with the business.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're hiring our first dedicated Talent Acquisition Specialist to own hiring for our growing team, from approved job brief through to accepted offer. This is a fully remote, work-from-home role. You'll work closely with our HR Business Partner, who looks after every new team member from onboarding onward.



You'll also work directly with the founders. This is a great opportunity for an experienced recruiter who wants real ownership, visibility and a direct hand in building a business. The founders are busy, so you'll need to run your work autonomously, make sound calls without being chased, and manage up: flag risks early, push for decisions and keep them informed without waiting to be asked.



Excellent written and spoken communication is key. You'll be the first point of contact for every candidate and a daily voice to the founders, so clear, confident and professional English is essential.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Run several hiring processes at once, targeting 3–7 successful hires per month

- Write clear, compelling job ads and post them across OnlineJobs.ph, Indeed, JobStreet and SEEK

- Track ad results and improve titles, copy, screening questions and channels when results fall short

- Proactively source passive candidates rather than waiting for applications

- Screen applicants and run first-round interviews covering skills, communication, motivation and fit

- Present a qualified shortlist within 7 business days, explaining why each candidate fits and flagging any concerns

- Coordinate final interviews, reference checks and offers

- Keep every candidate informed, including timely closure for unsuccessful applicants

- Hand over each new hire to our HR Business Partner, and review past hires together to sharpen future hiring

- Report weekly to the founders on open roles, pipeline, ad performance and expected hires

- Use AI tools to work faster, while keeping judgement and candidate communication human



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Excellent written and spoken English – this is essential

- Proven experience independently managing multiple hiring processes at the same time

- Hands-on experience with OnlineJobs.ph, Indeed, JobStreet and/or SEEK, including paid ads and active sourcing

- A confident interviewer with sound judgement of capability and fit

- Comfort using data to change your approach

- Practical, everyday use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude

- Self-driven and able to work autonomously, with the confidence to manage up to senior leaders

- Highly organised, proactive and able to keep momentum without close supervision

- A reliable home setup with a quiet workspace and stable internet

- Discretion with confidential information

- Bonus: experience recruiting Filipino talent for Australian companies, or retail and fashion industry experience



WHAT YOU'LL GET



- US$250 per week base pay

- US$50 for every successful hire – at 3–7 hires a month, that's an extra US$150–350 monthly

- Employment through our Philippine company, with SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, 13th month pay and HMO health cover

- Paid leave

- A fully remote, work-from-home role

- A positive, supportive team culture

- A long-term role working directly with the founders of a fast-growing business



HOW TO APPLY



Attention to detail matters in this role. Start your application with the words "Talent First", then answer these two questions:



1. Which platforms have you recruited on, and roughly how many hires did you make in the last 12 months?

2. In under 150 words, tell us about the hardest role you've filled: what it was, how you found the candidate and how long it took.



Please attach your CV. Applications that don't follow these instructions won't be reviewed.

title: Telehealth Patient Care Manager / Customer Success Manager
description:
Hiring: Telehealth Patient Care Manager / Customer Success Manager



Company: HeroMD & SanaDirect

Location: Remote (Must work US hours)

Position: Full-Time



About the Role



We’re looking for an experienced Telehealth Customer Success Manager to oversee patient care and customer support operations across two fast-growing US telehealth brands.



This is NOT a traditional e-commerce customer support position.



We need someone who genuinely understands the telehealth industry, has experience working with patients, medical providers, pharmacies, and prescription workflows, and knows how to build and manage a high-performing patient care team.



You’ll be responsible for ensuring our patients receive excellent service while making sure our operations run efficiently as we scale.



Responsibilities



* Patient Care Operations: Oversee the entire patient support journey, from initial consultation and prescription approval through medication fulfillment, refills, and ongoing care.

* Team Management: Manage, train, and hold our patient care/customer support representatives accountable for performance and quality.

* Telehealth Workflows: Understand and manage issues involving prescriptions, medical consultations, pharmacy fulfillment, refill requests, and provider escalations.

* Patient Retention: Improve patient satisfaction, reduce cancellations, and optimize the refill and subscription experience.

* SOP Development: Build and implement clear patient care procedures, escalation protocols, and quality assurance systems.

* Medical Coordination: Work closely with our medical providers, pharmacy partners, and internal operations teams to resolve patient issues.

* Compliance: Ensure patient communications and support processes follow HIPAA requirements and appropriate healthcare protocols.

* Performance Management: Track response times, resolution rates, CSAT, retention, and support team productivity.

* Escalations: Personally handle complex patient situations when needed, including medical-related complaints that require escalation to licensed clinicians.



Requirements



* 3+ years of experience in US telehealth, digital health, or prescription-based healthcare operations.

* Previous experience managing a patient care, customer success, or healthcare support team.

* Strong understanding of the US telehealth patient journey, including consultations, prescriptions, pharmacies, and medication fulfillment.

* Experience with EHR/EMR systems, healthcare CRMs, and support platforms.

* Working knowledge of HIPAA and patient privacy requirements.

* Experience with subscription-based healthcare or recurring medication programs is strongly preferred.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication.

* Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing operations in a fast-growing company.



Strongly Preferred



Experience working at companies such as Hims & Hers, Ro, LifeMD, Henry Meds, or similar direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.



Experience supporting GLP-1 weight management, men’s health, or other recurring prescription treatments is a major plus.



What We’re Looking For



We want someone who can own our entire patient care operation, not someone who simply manages tickets.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Japanese Product Reels/TikTok) – $6 per Set (1 Main + 2 Hook Variations) Romaji Script Provided
description:
We produce short vertical product videos (15–60 seconds) in Japanese for Instagram Reels and TikTok for an Amazon affiliate business. We are looking for reliable editors for ongoing, template-based work.



Japanese is NOT required. We give you a romaji (Japanese written in English letters) version of every script, so you can check the AI voiceover by listening and comparing it with the romaji script. Our Japanese team handles any remaining quality issues.



What we provide for each set

• A Japanese script (for captions) and a romaji script (for the reading check).

• All footage, collected by our sourcing team. Use only the supplied footage.

• A project template (Premiere Pro or CapCut), the designated fonts, and a caption style guide.



Your tasks for each set

• Put the Japanese script into captions (copy and paste; do not rewrite the text).

• Generate the Japanese AI voiceover with our designated tool and settings.

• Listen to every line and compare it with the romaji script to check for misreadings. Fix misreadings before editing, and tell us about anything unclear.

• Edit the short video with the supplied footage, following the template and the designated fonts.

• Make 2 hook variations (see below).



Hook variations (3 videos per set)

• Each set = 1 main video + 2 hook variations.

• In each hook variation, change ONLY the order of the supplied clips in the first ~3 seconds. Do not write new text and do not add new footage.

• Everything after the first ~3 seconds must be identical to the main video.

• File names: 01_main.mp4, 01_hookA.mp4, 01_hookB.mp4 (the number is the set number).



Software: Adobe Premiere Pro or CapCut (your own licensed software).

Estimated time: about 20–30 minutes per main video once you are used to the template (our estimate). Hook variations are shot-order changes only.



Payment

• Fixed price: $6 per set (1 main video + 2 hook variations), including AI voiceover generation and the misreading check.

• Paid test: $6 for one set. We will test 3 editors with the same task.

• Revisions: one consolidated round of revisions per set is included. Mistakes on your side (typos, misreadings, spec violations) are fixed free of charge and do not count as a revision.

• Optional add-on – footage research: if you can also do our footage research task (finding the same video as a reference video on RED/Xiaohongshu and TikTok and pasting the URL into our spreadsheet), we add +$0.25 per research item on top of the editing rate.

• No minimum volume is guaranteed.



When you apply, please answer

1. Links to 2–3 vertical short videos you edited, and what you did in each.

2. How will you check that the AI voiceover matches the romaji script line by line? (Japanese is not required.)

3. Which software do you use: Premiere Pro or CapCut?

4. Do you accept $6 per set (including the $6 paid test)?

5. Are you also interested in the footage research add-on (+$0.25 per item)?

6. Your time zone, working hours, and how many sets you can do per week.

title: Fund Accountant
description:
Fund Accountant – Property Fund - MUST HAVE AUSTRALIAN EXPERIENCE

Deltine Capital |  Remote (Australia), Contract 



Deltine Capital acquires and operates regional motels through the Deltine High Yield Motel Fund. The Fund is in an active growth phase, adding assets through a steady pipeline of acquisitions, each of which brings a new property entity and operating business into the reporting group. Through only 18months of trading Deltine has managed to acquire over $100 million in assets with a steady pipeline of opportunities to continue this trend.

We are hiring a Fund Accountant to own financial reporting and controlling activities across the investment entities. A bookkeeping team handles day-to-day processing at the asset level. This role reviews and signs off that work and owns everything above it including consolidation and investment reporting. It reports directly to the CFO, with a clear management path as the portfolio scales.

About the Employer

Deltine Capital manages a fund that is building a portfolio of regional motels targeting 4-star quality for professionals and business travellers. The motel sector is fragmented, and many independent properties lack scale, resources and expertise. Deltine’s approach is active asset management: economies of scale, targeted upgrades and operational improvement across a growing platform. The finance function sits close to the assets, and fund accounting, asset accounting and treasury are handled by a small but fast growing team.

Why this role

• You own fund accounting end to end. Consolidations, Distributions, NAV and covenant reporting, trustee instructions and the financial content of investor reporting. There are no layers between you and the CFO.

• You are the financial controller for the portfolio. Every motel entity’s month-end crosses your desk before it is final, and the balance sheet of every entity is yours to stand behind. Every new acquisition keeps the workload dynamic

• Treasury is yours to run. Daily cash management across the Fund and the motel entities, and the funding of settlements as acquisitions land.

• Join a market disruptor. Make a real contribution to a new and fast moving commercial property sector



What you’ll do

Financial control across the motel entities

• Monthly balance sheet review, ensuring all entity balances are reconciled and verified.

• Review and sign-off of month-end prepared by the bookkeeping team: accruals and prepayments, fixed asset registers and depreciation, intercompany reconciliations, and employment-related accruals.

• Consolidation of asset financial statements into the Fund reporting pack.

• Budget loading and variance reporting in Xero. Support the CFO and COO on periodical budgets for the motels and the Fund.

• Maintain the three-way forecast (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and capital allowance forecasting.

• Directing workflow and accounting guidance for the finance team based offshore.

Fund accounting and reporting

• Monthly distribution calculations, including updates to the Fund cash flow model, for CFO and CEO approval.

• Quarterly NAV reporting and bank covenant reporting.

• Prepare the financial content of quarterly investor reporting and support the CFO on external queries.

• Proper Instructions to the trustee for investor unit allocations, distributions and fund payments, including acquisition and closing fees.

• Trustee compliance reporting and responses to trustee requests. eg related party register.

• Distribution tax components, and annual tax, with the external tax adviser.

• Support the annual audit: auditor liaison, information requests and resolution of queries across the Fund and motel entities.



Treasury and cash management

• Daily cash management across the Fund and motel entities: sufficient operating funds at each motel, surplus cash invested, and transfers between entities.  Payment Authorisation.

• Fund settlements: cash calls, drawdowns and settlement funding in step with the acquisition timetable. 

What we’re looking for

• CA or CPA, with at least six years’ experience in Investment accounting for an Australian company.

• Property fund accounting experience, ideally across unlisted trusts or a registered scheme.

• Working knowledge of consolidations, unit trust distributions and tax component calculations.

• Hands-on treasury experience: cash forecasting, multi-entity cash management and payment controls.

• A controller’s instinct. You are comfortable reviewing other people’s work, and you can tell a reconciled balance sheet from one that only looks reconciled.

• Xero (financial reporting) and Spotlight (consolidation) experience is an advantage 

Experience

We would consider the following experience relevant:

• Fund accounting at an unlisted property fund manager, syndicator or REIT.

• Third-party fund administration with exposure to unit trust distributions and unit registry.

• Financial control in hotels, accommodation or other operating-business property sectors such as hospitality, childcare or healthcare, where the asset and the business are intertwined.

• Mid-tier audit or business services with a property and funds client base, moving into industry.

title: Video Editor
description:
Company: Bearaby

Employment Type: Full-Time

Company Size: 11–50 Employees



WHO WE ARE

Bearaby is an award-winning Direct to Consumer (DTC) company on a mission to bring comfort and relief to people of all ages who are searching for calm in a complex world.

We create beautiful and functional products, including our flagship weighted blankets, that are sustainably manufactured from organic materials and innovative upcycled fabrics – loom to lap.

We believe that restorative rest should be simple, natural, and drug-free – and that it's time to ditch the negative stigmas around healthy habits like napping and sleeping-in for a calmer, more collected world.



ROLE SUMMARY

We are seeking a full-time Video Editor to join our creative team and support the production of video content for Bearaby's marketing channels.

In this role, you'll work closely with our creative and marketing teams to edit videos that showcase our products, tell customer stories, and promote our sustainable mission, primarily for social media channels.

This is a flexible, full-time role perfect for someone who has a passion for storytelling through visual content and can work independently in a fast-paced environment.



DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES



• Video Editing: Edit raw footage into polished, on-brand video content for use across Bearaby's digital and social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, website, etc.). Focus on creating short-form videos, product videos, customer testimonials, and more.
